Query: Give me the kings of Castile who have a daughter married to a king of England.
Response:
```lambda-calculus
λx.king(x, castile) ∧ ∃y.(daughter(y, x) ∧ ∃z.(king(z, england) ∧ married_to(y, z)))
```
